owner_and_capability: Request Review read projection (request-review-view): the shared staff list of parent requests with origin, type, child, requested change and decision, plus the pending-count badge, over consumer-owned queue ports
atomic_cutover: One read-only projection serves GET /students/change-requests (open and history) and /students/change-requests/pending-count. api/base.go composes it over the retained review queues; api/students switched both routes in one deploy (#3156), and the four-service fan-out handler, its history mappers and the conflict scan are deleted from the HTTP package. The per-type wire shapes live in the projection's public package so the decide, preview and detail routes keep answering with the same shapes. No table changes owner; the projection persists nothing. The list serves the parent offering switches (enrollment.offering_change_requests); the public enrollment change requests (enrollment.change_requests) keep their config:manage-gated list (#2435), which the client merges into the same Eltern list on occurred_at, so the projection does not cross that permission boundary. The staff RSS feed (/students/change-requests/rss-feed) keeps its registered parent-request-feed-read-model projection: it postdates the evidence commit, and moving it needs edges and a grant the PR-mode ratchet refuses (see exit_criterion).
tests: Output parity: TestRequestReviewGolden records 41 responses of the production students router (34 single requests and three cursor chains) over one fixed fixture with all four queues open and decided: the merged order and type tie-break, keyset paging to the last page, every type, search, student, status and date-range filter, empty pages, every malformed-query 400, the 403 gates, the absence-only 403 contract, the narrowing of a reviewer without users:update to the excused queue, the group-leader scope with the school setting off and on, and the badge per caller. api/students/testdata/request_review.golden.json was written by the pre-cutover fan-out reader (939126a901) running the same file; the projection reproduces it byte for byte, and a fresh process with new synthetic IDs does too. Urgency phases (wall clock on the old reader), weekly-plan requests and booking corrections stay with the projection unit tests and the direct-corrections router test.

No retained api/students expectation was edited: the in-package handler tests and the router tests over real keyset SQL pin JSON output, cursor contract, filters, permission narrowing and the badge. Pure projection tests cover ordering, tie-break, paging, urgency phases, filters, empty pages, cursor progress over filtered rows, past consequences, conflict grouping, decorations and error passthrough; adapter tests pin the owner-rule facts per row, the filter/cursor translation, the badge counts and one owner-queue failure surfacing through the existing error contract; a two-tenant RLS proof over all four request tables runs the real retained queues under the least-privilege role with a query budget.

runtime_evidence.source: docs/runtime-checkpoints/request-review-2705.md with the baseline and candidate logs and the baseline and candidate plan files beside it; harness backend/api/students/change_request_review_runtime_test.go
runtime_evidence.workload: Local PostgreSQL 17.11, Go 1.27.0, package test database; baseline fixed at 939126a901 in a detached worktree, candidate at 78f35b2996; open list, history and pending-count over 0, 8 and 32 children with one pending request per queue and three decided requests each; five warmups and 30 samples per request, concurrency 1, both runs alone on the machine. After the 32-child samples the harness explains every distinct read statement shape under the least-privilege role, outside the timer and the counter.
runtime_evidence.thresholds: No new SLO. Statement, returned-row and plan parity with the pre-cutover reader per scenario; local same-workload comparison, not staging/production parity. Budget modules.requestreview.open_page (max 101) for the fixture-sized open page. The two readers are within run-to-run variation at p50 (32 children/open: 218.65 ms candidate against 222.53 ms baseline in this run, 19% above in #3156's run) with byte-identical statement and row counts; no regression issue.
runtime_evidence.query_count: Identical on both sides: open 14/320/728, history 10/19/19, pending-count 8/156/564 statements for 0/8/32 children; driver-reported rows 3/590/1550, 2/92/322 and 1/209/833. Plans at 32 children: open 38 read shapes and 724 read statements scanning an estimated 79,000 rows for 1,550 returned; history 11 shapes, about 73,000 scanned for 322; pending-count 21 shapes, about 3,900 scanned for 833. Shapes, rows and buffer hits are identical on both sides, no block was read from disk, the only sequential scan is enrollment.request_child_offerings. The scanned rows come from the retained queues' child-name search evaluated in a nested loop per request row; that and the per-row hydration are owner-side follow-ups, unchanged by the cutover.
runtime_evidence.errors: Zero unexpected errors, zero write rows, zero pool waits, zero deadlocks and no lock sample with a waiting backend in either run; all 540 measured requests per reader answered 200. No projection cache. Both stored logs retain the full per-sample arrays (duration, queries, rows affected, write rows, pool wait count and duration). The golden pins the malformed-query 400 body, the 403 bodies and the absence-only 403 contract identically to the pre-cutover reader.
runtime_evidence.failure: One owner-queue failure surfaces unchanged (errors.Is and 500 text) through the shared parent-request error rules; a missing queue or access port fails composition with ErrIncompleteSources; malformed queries answer 400 with the unchanged invalid-query error.
runtime_evidence.rollback: Projection persists nothing; every measured write_rows_affected was zero. Revert api/base.go and the api/students wiring to restore the retained fan-out handler without data migration.
runtime_evidence.smoke: Production students router with signed JWT, permission gates and tenant transaction serves all three routes for the admin reviewer; the absence-only reviewer keeps seeing only the excused queue and the group leader only the children of the led group (router test and golden). The staging check after #3156's deploy (recorded on #2705) was a read-only health check, not an old-versus-new comparison.

rollback_and_cleanup: Revert the consumer wiring (api/base.go composition, api/students handlers) as a whole while the retained queues remain intact; the read-only projection owns no authoritative state. The fan-out was deleted in #3156, before a golden existed; the output golden now backs that deletion locally, and the staging check after the deploy was a read-only health check, not an old-versus-new comparison. The adapter's compatibility permissions convert to exact debt under #3174, now that the packages exist at a base SHA; the inbound-students adapter import goes when the decide routes move to their owners. No deployment or staging/production requests for this evidence.
exit_criterion: The ticket's named consumers, the staff open list, the decision history and the badge, read the one projection with byte-identical output to the pre-cutover reader, tenant safety and no direct cross-owner reads in api/students, and their query plans match the pre-cutover reader shape for shape. #2705 is rescoped to those consumers: the request-review-view.* compatibility permissions convert to exact debt under #3174, now that the packages exist at the base SHA, and the staff RSS feed, added after the evidence commit, keeps its registered parent-request-feed-read-model projection because it also announces config:manage enrollment change requests, selects by submission instant and costs one statement, and because care-plan/compose and care-plan/postgres may not import request-review-view/public, request-review-view/adapter and root-composition/compose may not import parent-request-feed-view/postgres, a new rule between existing role points is a policy loosening, and PR mode grants read_projections only to a newly created projection owner; moving it needs a reviewed policy decision under #2580. enrollment.change_requests stays behind its own config:manage list by design (#2435). No ratchet key added or removed, composition surface unchanged, ownership and policy epoch 5 preserved.
